I have everything needed. Here is the complete picture.

## Summary

This is a redesign-in-progress. The codebase is in three inconsistent states for `customerCode`:
- **Implementation** (`AssignCustomerCode.java`) produces `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (per-city sequence).
- **openapi.yml doc** describes yet another old format `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (global sequence).
- **Acceptance tests** (Cp09/14/16/21/31/32) already assert the *target* design `<REGION>-<HASH8>` where HASH8 = `SHA-256(telephone + lastName)[0:8]` upper-hex. These tests are currently failing and define what the redesign must produce.

## Build system & running tests

- Build file: `/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml` (Maven; wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`). Inherits `spring-boot-starter-parent`; OfficeFloor `4.0.2` via `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (pom.xml:90-92).
- Tests are JUnit 5 acceptance tests in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`, each tagged (`@Tag("cp09")` etc.). No custom surefire/failsafe config.
- Run all: `./mvnw test` from `/home/daniel/sandbox`. Run one checkpoint: `./mvnw test -Dgroups=cp09` (or `-Dtest=Cp09Tests`). `OwnerDto` is code-generated from `openapi.yml` at build time (not a source file).

## 1. Files referencing the relevant terms

Main (all under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/`):
- `AssignCustomerCode.java` — builds customerCode
- `AuditOwnerCreated.java` — create audit record
- `ValidatePostcode.java` — postcode/region validation (400)
- `CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java` — per-city sequence/capacity (409)
- `AssignNamesakeCount.java`, `BuildOwner.java` — set fields feeding derivations
- `OwnerIdentityKey.java` — identity key

Mapper / model / DTO source:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — membershipNumber, checkDigit, locality, membershipLevel, region-from-postcode
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java` — `customerCode` field (col `customer_code`), postcode, registrationDate, namesakeCount
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (lines ~2097-2184) — DTO field schemas

Wiring YAML:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` (assignCode step at line 68, audit at 87)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`

Tests (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/.../acceptance/`):
- `AcceptanceBase.java` (helpers: `shaHex`, `sha256hex`, `luhn`, `knownOwner`, `CITY_REGION`, `REGION_POSTCODES`)
- `AuditLogCapture.java` (captures `AUDIT` logger)
- `Cp09` (customer-code), `Cp16` (customer-code-city), `Cp32` (global-id), `Cp31` (check-digit), `Cp14` (membership-number), `Cp21` (audit-create), `Cp17`/`Cp30` (locality), `Cp15`/`Cp23`/`Cp24` (membershipLevel)

## 2. Current customerCode logic

`AssignCustomerCode.java:16-26`:
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
    String city = owner.getCity();
    String city3 = city.substring(0, Math.min(3, city.length())).toUpperCase();
    String lastName = owner.getLastName();
    String last3 = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(3, lastName.length())).toUpperCase();
    long inCity = ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
        .filter(existing -> city.equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getCity()))
        .count();
    long sequence = inCity + 1;
    owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
}
```
Format `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`: first 3 letters of city (upper), first 3 of lastName (upper), and a 4-digit zero-padded per-city sequence = (count of existing owners in same city, case-insensitive) + 1. Runs before save (POST.yml:68, step `assignCode`), so the count excludes the new owner. City capacity capped at 50 by `CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java` (409 when `inCity >= 50`).

## 3. Membership number & check digit

Both in `OwnerMapper.java`, mapped onto the DTO at lines 25-26.

membershipNumber (`OwnerMapper.java:119-125`): `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, YY = last two digits of registrationDate year via `Math.floorMod(year,100)`, `%02d`. Returns null if customerCode or registrationDate absent.
```java
int yy = Math.floorMod(owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear(), 100);
return String.format("%s-M%02d", owner.getCustomerCode(), yy);
```

checkDigit (`OwnerMapper.java:131-154`): standard Luhn over only the digit characters in customerCode, right-to-left, doubling starting with the rightmost digit (`dbl=true` initially), result `(10 - sum%10) % 10`. Returns null when customerCode absent. (The test helper `AcceptanceBase.luhn` at lines 302-321 is byte-identical.)

## 4. Create audit record

`AuditOwnerCreated.java:19-23` — runs after save (POST.yml:87 step `audit`), logs at INFO on a dedicated SLF4J logger named `"AUDIT"`:
```java
AUDIT.info("Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
    owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(),
    ownerMapper.membershipLevel(owner));
```
Carries id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel. `Cp21Tests` asserts the line contains id + customerCode + registrationDate (via `AuditLogCapture`).

## 5. Locality derivation

`OwnerMapper.locality` (`OwnerMapper.java:57-63`): postcode range wins first, else city table, else `"UNKNOWN"`:
```java
default String locality(Owner owner) {
    String byPostcode = regionFromPostcode(owner.getPostcode());
    if (byPostcode != null) return byPostcode;
    return CITY_REGION.getOrDefault(owner.getCity(), "UNKNOWN");
}
```
`regionFromPostcode` (lines 72-93): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; null if absent/non-numeric/out-of-range. It is deliberately `private` to avoid MapStruct treating a `String->String` method as an implicit conversion. `CITY_REGION` (lines 46-47): `Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD`. The same postcode ranges/regions are enforced at input time by `ValidatePostcode.java` (400 on malformed or out-of-region postcode).

Note: the openapi.yml locality description (lines 2166-2174) only mentions the city table and omits the postcode-first rule — another doc/impl drift.

## 6. Tests and what they assert

- `Cp09Tests` / `Cp16Tests`: `customerCode == "NSW-" + shaHex(telephone + lastName, 8)` for a Sydney owner (postcode 2000). Target format `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex chars of SHA-256(telephone+lastName).
- `Cp32Tests`: `customerCode` matches regex `[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9A-F]{8}`.
- `Cp31Tests`: `checkDigit == luhn(customerCode)` recomputed from the returned code.
- `Cp14Tests`: `membershipNumber == customerCode + "-M" + <YY>` where YY = chars [2,4) of registrationDate.
- `Cp21Tests`: an `AUDIT` log line contains id, customerCode, and registrationDate.
- `Cp17Tests`: Sydney (postcode 2000) -> `locality == "NSW"`.
- `Cp30Tests`: postcode preferred over city — unknown city + postcode 3000 -> `locality == "VIC"`; Sydney/2000 -> `NSW`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of lastName, a hyphen, and a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence one greater than the owner count at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year."
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level assigned on creation. Starts at 1; add 1 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                capped at 3. (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city using the fixed table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

## What I changed

Owner identity is now `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, with every derived value flowing from that new identity:

1. **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — rewritten to build `<REGION>-<HASH8>` where `HASH8` is the first 8 upper-case hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)`. 2. **`OwnerRegion.java`** (new) — the single source of truth for the REGION code: postcode range first (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), then the fixed city table, else `UNKNOWN`. Shared by the customerCode and the locality.

3. **`OwnerMapper.locality()`** — now derives locality from the region-and-hash identity (the REGION prefix of the `customerCode`), falling back to `OwnerRegion.of(owner)` for owners with no code (seed data). The old private `regionFromPostcode` helper was removed.

4. **`membershipNumber` / `checkDigit` / audit record** — no code change needed; they already derive generically from `customerCode`, so they automatically carry the new identity (verified by Cp14, Cp31, Cp21).

5. **Docs** — updated the `assignCode` step comment in `owners.POST.yml` and the `customerCode`/`locality` descriptions in `openapi.yml` to match the new design.

Ordering holds: `ValidateOwnerFields` normalizes the telephone to E.164 and `ValidatePostcode`/`BuildOwner` set both fields on the entity before `assignCode` runs, so the hash input and region are exactly what the response reports back.
